answer.reason: The product screenshot slider is the Carousel component (reference name "carousel", content item 151 in the Carousel container). Its "Slides" field is a nested grid whose content model is carouselSlide, so each new slide is a carouselSlide item (heading, description, background image, CTA). Other candidates don't fit: GalleryImage has no heading or CTA, BentoCard and FeatureItem belong to other components, and the Carousel's own agent guidance points to carouselSlide for slides. I could not open content item 151 to view the existing slide fields, because the get_content_item tool was not granted permission. Nothing was saved.
